label: Buyer desire
description: Would a real buyer pay to wear or gift this exact idea because of a concrete emotional/social trigger? Mere recognition of job vocabulary scores low.

label: Clarity at glance
description: Can a viewer quickly understand the human premise or punchline, not merely parse technical steps?

label: Distinctiveness
description: Is there an original point of view, joke, situation, identity signal or visual premise? Rare jargon by itself is not distinctiveness.

label: Giftability
description: Is there a plausible recipient/occasion and a reason a giver would choose this exact idea over generic profession merch?

label: Insider resonance
description: Does it capture a shared situation, frustration, pride point, ritual or truth insiders recognize? Jargon density alone does not count.

label: IP safety
description: Can the exact premise, wording and visual be executed without protected brands, slogans, characters, copied graphics or misleading claims?

label: Niche fit
description: Does the concept genuinely belong to this audience without depending on job-title labeling or vocabulary lists?

label: Visual potential
description: Can the human idea become a strong apparel composition rather than a diagram, checklist or training graphic?

label: Channel breadth
description: Usefulness beyond one marketplace/channel and fit with broader Town Label commerce/content.

label: Competition opportunity
description: Room for differentiated offers; higher means less commoditized/copycat pressure relative to demand.

label: Concept depth
description: How many materially different authentic hooks can be developed without repeating the same joke/text.

label: Demand evidence
description: Evidence that a real buyer population actively searches, buys, gifts or identifies with this niche.

label: Founder/domain edge
description: Advantage from first-hand knowledge, access, community understanding or easier validation.

label: Identity intensity
description: How strongly people self-identify with the niche and enjoy signaling membership.

label: Legal/IP safety
description: Relative ability to create without leaning on protected brands, logos, characters or risky claims.

label: Purchase motivation
description: Strength of plausible reasons to buy beyond generic job-title decoration.

label: Repeatability
description: Ability to support a series, variants, seasons, gifts or repeat purchase.

label: Visual language
description: Availability of recognizable symbols, tools, situations, environments and insider cues for strong art.
